feature: CAD upload runs cost + DFM analysis
story: As a manufacturing engineer, I want to drop a CAD file (STL/STEP/STP/IGES/IGS) so that the part is costed and DFM-analyzed in one pass.
expected: Cold-start dropzone accepts CAD_ACCEPT types; on drop it fires POST /api/proxy/validate/cost (multipart: file, qty, cavities, complexity, material_class, units, optional shop/overrides) and POST /api/proxy/validate?units=... in parallel. Unsupported extension shows 'Unsupported file type' error without any request; an invalid qty list opens the options panel with 'Fix the quantity list before submitting.' Loading panes show per-tab spinner copy; session cookie is forwarded by the same-origin proxy (page redirects to /login when unauthenticated).
evidence: frontend/src/app/(app)/analyze/page.tsx; frontend/src/components/workspace/PartWorkspace.tsx L341-358, L307-339, L454-497; frontend/src/lib/api.ts L980-1063; frontend/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx L35
notes: Dropzone accept='.stl,.step,.stp,.iges,.igs'; drop fired POST /api/proxy/validate/cost + POST /api/proxy/validate?units=mm in parallel (<3s apart, both 200). bad.txt -> 'Unsupported file type' with zero validate requests; qty 'abc' -> options panel opened with 'Fix the quantity list before submitting.' and no request. Routing-tab loading copy 'Analyzing across all manufacturing processes…' observed. Anonymous /analyze redirected to /login?next=%2Fanalyze.

story: As an engineer, I want tabs (Decision, Routing & DFM, Glass Box, Compare, History) and a Role Lens so that I can view the same report through my role's landing lens without anything being walled off.
expected: /analyze lands on the 'mfg' role whose lens maps to the Routing & DFM tab; changing the role switches the landing tab (cost role also opens the Inspector). Glass Box and Compare tabs show EmptyState ('No cost breakdown yet' / 'Nothing to compare yet') until a cost report exists. 'New part' resets all state back to the dropzone.
notes: Five tabs (Decision|Routing & DFM|Glass Box|Compare|History). /analyze lands on Routing & DFM (mfg lens); switching to Cost eng landed on Glass Box and auto-opened the Inspector (default tab Sources); Sourcing landed on Compare. With no cost report (broken part) Glass Box showed 'No cost breakdown yet' and Compare 'Nothing to compare yet'. 'New part' reset to the cold-start dropzone.

story: As a manufacturing engineer, I want DFM findings linked to the 3D part so that clicking a face or a blocker highlights the exact geometry.
expected: On the Routing tab, clicking a mesh face that belongs to an issue's affected_faces_sample selects that issue and highlights its faces in a severity-mapped hex color (ghosting the rest); selecting an issue in the list highlights its faces. Highlighting a process with no geometry-linked faces raises a toast 'No geometry-linked faces reported for <process>'.
notes: Selecting an OVERHANG issue row highlighted its faces ('shown in 3D' + 'Highlighting OVERHANG' note, severity-colored); clicking the DFM-matrix draft blocker selected/highlighted the injection-molding issue. Canvas face-click and the no-geometry-linked-faces toast were not deterministically exercisable on this part (every matrix blocker had geometry-linked issues); not observed to fail.

story: As a cost engineer, I want to bind a shop profile, override rates, and save scenarios so that estimates use real calibrated numbers I can recall.
expected: GET /api/proxy/shops populates bindable shop profiles; selecting one re-runs POST /validate/cost with shop=<id> and toasts 'Calibrating to <name>…'. Applying an override or cavity count re-costs server-side with overrides JSON; 'Clear overrides' resets them. 'Save as scenario' stores a session-local chip (label = shop · overrides · qty) whose click recalls those options and re-costs; scenarios are lost on reset.
notes: GET /api/proxy/shops listed 2 profiles; picking 'Midwest Precision CNC' toasted 'Calibrating to Midwest Precision CNC…', re-ran POST /validate/cost and flipped the badge to 'Calibrated to'. Glass Box driver rate editor applied an override (toast 'Override … — re-costing', server re-cost, '1 override applied' chip); 'Reset overrides' re-cost + 'Cleared overrides' toast. 'Save as scenario' stored a session chip (shop · ovr · qty label); clicking the chip recalled options and re-cost. Scenarios cleared on reset.

story: As a user, I want honest failure states so that a broken mesh or server error tells me what to do instead of a blank screen.
expected: A 400 with code GEOMETRY_INVALID from POST /validate/cost renders the CostGeometryInvalidCard (reason + measured geometry) and a 'Geometry invalid' badge instead of a generic error. Other cost failures render ErrorState with a Retry that re-costs; DFM failure renders 'Analysis unavailable' with retry re-running POST /validate. 429 and 5xx raise toasts ('Rate limit exceeded…', 'Server error. We've been notified.').
notes: qa-broken.stl: POST /validate/cost returned 400 GEOMETRY_INVALID; UI rendered the CostGeometryInvalidCard (repair reason + measured volume/watertight geometry) and a 'Geometry invalid' header badge — no generic error. Screenshot APP-005-geometry-invalid-card.png. Generic cost/DFM ErrorState retries and 429/5xx toasts could not be force-triggered in this environment (no fault injection); no deviation observed.

story: As an engineer, I want unit-ambiguity warnings and a lineage Inspector so that I can trust and trace the numbers.
expected: report.unit_warnings render in a persistent UnitWarningBanner until the user confirms mm vs inch and re-costs (re-cost re-runs BOTH cost and DFM with the declared units). The collapsible DecisionInspector anchors to the make-now stable-quantity estimate and exposes Lineage/Governance/Sources/Audit tabs (defaults to Sources for the cost role); overrides applied from it trigger a real server re-cost.
notes: Sub-plausible part (0.3mm cube) produced report.unit_warnings -> persistent [data-testid=cad-unit-warning] banner ('Confirm CAD source units…' + IMPLAUSIBLE_VOLUME message). Setting units=inch and 'Re-cost with these inputs' re-ran BOTH /validate/cost and /validate; banner cleared. Inspector: Lineage/Governance/Sources/Audit tabs, defaults to Sources for cost role, collapsible; a driver override applied from the Inspector Sources tab triggered a real server re-cost.

feature: History tab: scenarios, copy summary, durable artifact
story: As a user, I want a History tab so that I can recall session scenarios, copy a decision summary, and jump to durable cost decisions.
expected: With no report, EmptyState 'No history yet'. With a report: saved scenario chips (click recalls + re-costs), 'Open cost history' navigates to /cost-decisions, and 'Copy decision summary' writes a plaintext make-by/crossover/DFM summary to the clipboard (success/failure toasts). When the authed cost route persisted the decision (report.saved present and cost-persist UI flag on), a CostArtifactBar offers open/PDF/JSON/CSV/share actions against /cost-decisions/{id} endpoints.
notes: Empty state 'No history yet' with no report. With report: saved scenario chips recallable, 'Open cost history' navigated to /cost-decisions, 'Copy decision summary' wrote a plaintext make-by/crossover/DFM summary to the clipboard (verified content + 'Decision summary copied' toast). report.saved present -> CostArtifactBar rendered ('Saved to cost history' with Open in history/PDF/JSON/CSV/RFQ ZIP/Share actions).

story: As a user, I want to download the DFM report as PDF so that I can circulate it.

notes: GET /api/proxy/analyses/{id}/pdf downloaded 'qa-box-dfm-report.pdf' (valid %PDF, 29KB).

feature: Upload guards: size caps, concurrency, SSRF
story: As an operator, oversized or dangerous batch inputs are rejected before work is created.
expected: Declared Content-Length or streamed ZIP over BATCH_MAX_ZIP_BYTES returns 413; manifest over cap returns 413 BATCH_MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE; concurrency_limit outside 1-12 returns 422 INVALID_BATCH_CONCURRENCY; webhook_url resolving to internal ranges returns 400 webhook_url_rejected (SSRF guard); bad/zip-bomb archives return 400 without orphaned batches.
error_found: Bad archive returns 500 instead of 400: POST /api/v1/batch with a non-ZIP payload named .zip (STL bytes, application/zip) -> HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' (reproduced twice). Cause: batch_service.extract_zip_path_to_items opens zipfile.ZipFile which raises zipfile.BadZipFile; batch_router.py only catches ValueError around extraction, so BadZipFile escapes as an unhandled 500. Expected 400 per story.
notes: Other guards pass: concurrency_limit=99 -> 422 INVALID_BATCH_CONCURRENCY (min/max in body); webhook_url=169.254.169.254 -> 400 webhook_url_rejected (SSRF); no orphaned batch left after the 500 (list shows only legit batches). Size caps (413 zip/manifest) verified in code only per briefing (declared Content-Length check exists at batch_router.py:230-247); not exercised with real GB uploads.

feature: Structured error responses with stable codes
story: As an API consumer, I want every error to carry a stable machine-readable code, message, and doc_url so I can handle failures programmatically.
expected: Any HTTPException is wrapped as {code, message, doc_url[, detail]} using the stable map (400 BAD_REQUEST, 401 UNAUTHORIZED, 403 FORBIDDEN, 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 CONFLICT, 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE, 422 VALIDATION_ERROR, 429 RATE_LIMITED, 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED, 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, 504 ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT). A detail dict already containing 'code' (e.g. GEOMETRY_INVALID, SAM3D_ENQUEUE_FAILED) passes through unchanged with original headers; Pydantic validation failures return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.
notes: Observed envelope {code,message,doc_url} on every error: BAD_REQUEST (400s), NOT_FOUND (unknown route + unknown resources), FILE_TOO_LARGE (demo 413), VALIDATION_ERROR (Pydantic 422s incl. extra_forbidden and int_parsing), NOT_IMPLEMENTED (gmsh 501). Detail-dicts with own code pass through unchanged: GEOMETRY_INVALID, DIRECT_UPLOAD_* family, auth_missing (401), insufficient_role (403). 429 RATE_LIMITED and 409/503/504 codes not triggered (deliberately stayed under rate limits).

story: As a holder of an old docs link, I want /docs to forward me so that I land on the current API quickstart.
expected: /docs unconditionally issues a Next.js redirect to /developers; no content is rendered at /docs itself.
notes: curl confirms 307 redirect /docs -> /developers; browser lands on /developers.

story: As an analyst, I confirm/correct a part's declared identity so future retrievals carry a human assertion instead of a guess.
expected: Analyst role required; upserts declared_part_id/name/program onto the (org, mesh_hash) corpus row with source='user_confirmed' and emits identity.confirm audit event. 400 if caller has no org, mesh_hash blank, or no declared field supplied; 404 if the mesh has no corpus row in the caller's org (incl. another org's part — never a cross-tenant write, never a fabricated signature). Rate-limited 120/hour.
notes: Confirm upserts declared fields, source=user_confirmed/provenance USER (200); 400 no declared field; 400 blank mesh_hash; 404 unknown mesh; 404 cross-tenant confirm from second org (no write); identity.confirm audit event present; platform-viewer caller got 403 (analyst gate). Corpus row is created by POST /validate (not /validate/cost); no-org 400 branch untestable (signup always creates an org).

story: As an analyst, I bulk-upload my org's CAD library (files or ZIP) with an identity mapping so the corpus has real declared identities on day one.
expected: Analyst role + kill-switch open required; 403 if no org. Accepts multipart files and/or ZIP plus optional CSV/JSON mapping; 400 if no files, 413 if >512MB (env PARTS_MASTER_MAX_MB) or over ONBOARD_MAX_FILES cap, 400 if mapping is not UTF-8. Returns honest summary {onboarded, skipped:[{filename,reason}], mapping_errors, library_size} — unparseable files are skipped, never abort the batch; missing names onboard bare geometry with no guessing. Rate-limited 20/hour.
notes: Multipart onboard: 2 onboarded with CSV mapping (manifest_registered=2), qa-fake.stl honestly skipped with reason, batch not aborted; ZIP form onboarded 2 unnamed (bare geometry, no guessing); 400 no files; 400 non-UTF-8 mapping; honest summary shape {onboarded,skipped,mapping_errors,library_size}. 413 >512MB and >2000-file cap not exercised (impractical payload sizes); analyst gate verified via shared require_role.

story: As a viewer, I see my org's identity-corpus size and recent entries, and download the mapping CSV contract.
expected: Viewer role required. GET /library returns {library_size, recent:[...]} org-scoped with declared identity only (raw signature vector never emitted); 403 if caller has no org. GET /library/template returns text/csv with header 'filename' (required) + optional part_id/name/program/material_class and needs no org.
notes: GET /library org-scoped {library_size,recent[]} with declared identity only - no signature vector emitted; org B never sees org A rows. /library/template returns text/csv with header filename,part_id,name,program,material_class. Viewer-role caller allowed (200 as platform viewer). No-org 403 branch untestable (every account has an org).

story: As an analyst, I create a named org and become its admin.
expected: Analyst role + kill-switch open required; 201 with {org_id, name, slug, org_role:'admin'}; caller's active org is NOT auto-switched. 400 for empty name or name >200 chars. Emits org.created audit event.
notes: 201 {org_id,name,slug,org_role:admin}; active org NOT switched (list still showed personal org active); 400 empty name; 400 name>200; org.created audit event present; platform-viewer got 403 (analyst gate).

story: As a viewer, I list every org I belong to and see which is active.
expected: Viewer role required; returns caller's memberships with the active org flagged; no cross-user data.
notes: Returns only caller's memberships with is_active flag on the active org; second user's list shows only their own orgs.

story: As a member with a dashboard session, I switch my active org.
expected: Viewer role + kill-switch open; org-bound API keys are refused with 403 {code:'api_key_org_bound'} — only dashboard sessions may switch (keys are permanently org-bound). 403 'not a member of that organization' when switching to an org without membership. Emits org.switched.
notes: API key switch refused 403 {code:api_key_org_bound}; dashboard session switch to member org 200; switch to non-member org 403 'not a member'; org.switched audit events present.

story: As an org admin, I manage SAML group-to-role mappings for JIT provisioning in my org.
expected: Org-admin role required (mutations kill-switch gated); mappings are strictly org-scoped — list returns only caller-org rows, delete of another org's mapping fails. POST returns 201 with serialized mapping; both mutations emit saml.group_mapping.* audit events.
notes: POST 201 serialized mapping (invalid role 400 with allowed list admin/member/viewer); list strictly org-scoped (org B sees []); DELETE of org A mapping via org B admin key = 404; delete in own org works; saml.group_mapping.created/deleted audit events present.

story: As an org admin, I invite an email at a role and review my org's invites.
expected: Org-admin required; invited role may not exceed the inviter's (403). POST returns 201 with the one-time accept_link exactly once (token stored only as hash, never persisted raw) and emailed flag; email send is best-effort — missing RESEND config or send failure never breaks invite creation. GET lists org invites (pending/accepted/expired/revoked) with no tokens. Invite creation rate-limited 20/hour.
notes: POST 201 with one-time accept_link + emailed:false (no RESEND config, creation unaffected - best-effort confirmed); invalid role 400; GET lists invites with statuses and NO tokens; 21st create in an hour rate-limited 429 (20/hour). Role-exceeds-inviter 403 branch unreachable in practice (only org admins - top role - can invite).

story: As an invited user, I redeem the one-time token to join the org at the invited role.
expected: Any authed user (viewer+), kill-switch gated; token is hash-compared and single-use. 400 empty token; 404 unknown/used token; 409 revoked, already-used, or expired; 403 if the invite was issued to a different account/email. Accepting never escalates an existing member's role; returns {org_id, org_role, created} and emits member.joined only when a membership is created.
notes: 400 empty token; 404 unknown token; 403 when a different account redeems ('issued to a different account'); correct account joins with {org_id,org_role,created:true}; re-accept 409 'already been used'; revoked token 409; member.joined audit event present.

story: As an org admin, I revoke a pending invite so the link stops working.
expected: Org-admin required, kill-switch gated, org-scoped: 404 if the invite is absent (or belongs to another org), 409 if already accepted; returns the serialized invite with revoked state.
notes: Revoke from another org's admin = 404 (org-scoped); own-org revoke returns invite with status revoked + revoked_at; accepting revoked token 409; revoking accepted invite 409; unknown id 404.

story: As any org member (viewer+), I see my org's members and their org roles.
expected: Org viewer role required; returns only the caller's active org's members — no cross-org leakage; 403 if the caller has no org.
notes: Org member (viewer) sees active-org member list; results strictly bounded to caller's active org (org B list contains only org B's member); no cross-org leakage.

story: As an org admin, I change a member's org role.
expected: Org-admin required, kill-switch gated; 404 if the target is not a member of this org; 409 when demoting the last admin (an org must keep at least one admin). Emits member.role_changed and returns {user_id, org_role}.
notes: Admin changed member->viewer returning {user_id,org_role}; 404 non-member target; 409 demoting last admin; org-viewer caller got 403; member.role_changed audit event present.

story: As an org admin I remove a member, or as any member I leave the org myself.
expected: Route accepts org viewer, but a non-admin removing anyone other than themselves gets 403 {code:'insufficient_org_role'} — self-leave only. 404 if target not a member; 409 if the last admin would be removed or leave. Removal is org-scoped (not account deactivation) and takes effect immediately via membership re-validation; emits member.left/member.removed.
notes: Non-admin removing another member: 403 {code:insufficient_org_role}; self-leave by viewer succeeded and membership disappeared immediately from member list; 404 non-member; 409 removing last admin; member.left audit event present. Account remained active (org-scoped removal, not deactivation).

story: As an org admin I list and inspect only my org's users; as a superadmin I see all users platform-wide.
expected: require_org_role(admin): org-admin results are bounded by an INNER JOIN on memberships to ctx.org_id; a user outside the org returns 404 on detail so cross-org existence never leaks. Superadmin sees every user with primary (oldest) membership enriched. List is cursor-paginated (limit 1-100, next_cursor/has_more); detail includes org_role, auth_provider, analysis_count, batch_count.
notes: Org-admin list bounded to own org (INNER JOIN behavior observed); detail of outside-org user = 404 (no existence leak); own-user detail includes org_role, auth_provider, analysis_count, batch_count; superadmin sees all users with primary membership enriched; cursor pagination works (limit=2 -> next_cursor/has_more, followed page 2); limit 0/101 rejected 422; org-viewer caller 403.

story: As a platform superadmin, I change a user's global platform role.
expected: Superadmin only: an org-admin gets 403 {code:'platform_superadmin_required'} (org admins manage org_role on the org router, never users.role). 400 changing own role or role not in {viewer, analyst, admin} — 'superadmin' is deliberately not assignable via API; 404 unknown user. Emits user.role_changed with old/new roles.
notes: Org-admin got 403 {code:platform_superadmin_required}; 400 changing own role; 400 role=superadmin (not assignable); 404 unknown user; superadmin demoted analyst->viewer (verified viewer then 403s on analyst-gated routes, reads still work) and restored; user.role_changed audit events present (x3).

story: As a platform superadmin, I deactivate a compromised/offboarded account and later reactivate it.
expected: Superadmin only (deliberately not org-admin — deactivation is account-level and blocks EVERY auth path: login, Google/SAML/magic re-provision, existing sessions, API keys). Deactivate: 400 on self, 404 unknown user; flips is_active, sets deactivated_at, and bumps session_version so existing dashboard sessions die immediately. Reactivate reverses it; both idempotent (session_version only bumps on actual state change) and audited.
notes: Org-admin refused 403; 400 self-deactivate; 404 unknown user. Deactivation blocked API key (403), existing dashboard session (403) and password login (403); idempotent (second deactivate kept session_version=1); reactivate restored key access and bumped session_version; user.deactivated/user.reactivated audit events present.

story: As a platform superadmin, I invalidate every dashboard session for an account without deactivating it.
expected: Superadmin only; 404 unknown user. Bumps users.session_version so every existing dashboard cookie is invalidated on next validation while API keys and the account remain active; returns the new session_version and emits user.sessions_revoked.
notes: Superadmin only (org-admin 403, unknown user 404); returns new session_version; existing dashboard session died (401) while the API key kept working (200) and account stayed active; user.sessions_revoked audit event present.

story: As an org admin, I see real usage counts for my org's trailing window.
expected: Org-admin required; days param 1-90 (default 30). Returns separate honest counts (analyses, cost_decisions, usage_events, webhook_deliveries) plus per-event-type and per-webhook-status breakdowns from persisted tables — never invented aggregate numbers. Org-admin counts are filtered to ctx.org_id; superadmin is unfiltered (org_id null in response).
notes: Org-admin counts filtered to own org (analyses/cost_decisions/usage_events/webhook_deliveries + per-event-type and webhook-status breakdowns, real numbers); superadmin unfiltered with org_id:null; days out of 1-90 rejected (422 validation); org-viewer caller 403.

story: As an org admin, I inspect recent webhook delivery attempts and retry timing.
expected: Org-admin required; latest deliveries (limit 1-100) joined to batch ULID, org-scoped unless superadmin. Response contains status/attempts/response_code/retry timestamps but deliberately NEVER the payload body.
notes: Org-admin gate verified (viewer 403); returns {deliveries:[]} honestly - no webhook endpoints configured in env, so payload-exclusion and retry-timing fields could not be observed on real rows.

story: As an org admin/operator, I check async queue, batch, webhook, and worker posture.
expected: Org-admin required; returns PII-free summary scoped to the caller's org (superadmin sees platform-wide, org filter None).
notes: Org-admin required (viewer 403); returns PII-free async/jobs/batches/batch_items posture scoped to caller org (org_id echoed).

story: As an org admin, I query or CSV-export my org's audit trail for compliance.
expected: Org-admin required; start/end ISO datetimes mandatory (400 on invalid) with a hard 90-day max range (400 above). Org-admin sees only their org's entries, superadmin all orgs. format=csv returns text/csv attachment; default JSON is cursor-paginated (limit 1-200) with optional user_id/action filters.
notes: Missing start/end 422, invalid datetime 400, >90-day range 400; org-admin sees only own-org entries (14 vs org B's 2 vs superadmin's 119); action filter works; format=csv returns text/csv attachment audit-log.csv; JSON cursor-paginated. All expected audit actions observed (org.*, member.*, identity.confirm, saml.*, user.*, governance.*).

story: As an IdP (Okta/Entra) using an org-admin API key, I discover the SCIM capabilities.
expected: Bearer API-key auth + org-admin role; a token without an org context gets 403 {code:'scim_org_required'} — SCIM strictly requires an org-scoped admin key. Returns static SCIM 2.0 config/schema/resource-type documents.
notes: Org-admin API key returns static ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas/ResourceTypes (SCIM 2.0, patch supported, bulk not); no auth 401; org-viewer-bound key 403 insufficient_org_role. 403 {code:scim_org_required} for an org-less token untestable - every mintable key is org-bound.

story: As an IdP, I list, create, read, replace, and patch users in the customer org.
expected: Org-admin key required; all operations are bounded to the key's org. List supports startIndex/count (max 100) and SCIM filter. POST returns 201 and create_or_update upserts by userName; PUT preserves userName from the existing resource; PATCH requires the SCIM PatchOp schema when schemas is supplied (400 otherwise). Mutations are committed per request.
notes: List with startIndex/count and SCIM filter (userName eq) works, bounded to key's org; POST 201 creates (upsert by userName); GET by id 200; cross-org GET via second org's key = 404 SCIM error; PUT without userName preserves existing userName; PATCH with wrong schema 400, proper PatchOp schema applies active=false. Note: PUT supplying a *different* userName upserts by that userName (creates a new resource) per code's setdefault design.

story: As an IdP, I deprovision a user when they leave the customer's directory.
expected: Org-admin key required; DELETE is implemented as a PATCH setting active=false (soft deactivation, never a hard delete) and returns 204 with no body. Org-scoped — cannot deprovision users outside the key's org.
notes: DELETE returned 204 with no body; user still readable with active:false (soft deactivation, not hard delete); DELETE via another org's key = 404 (org-scoped).

story: As an IdP, I read and push group membership so directory groups drive org roles.
expected: Org-admin key required; groups are org-scoped, group_id accepts a path segment (:path converter). PATCH applies membership operations and commits; unknown group/org mismatch surfaces the service's error rather than crossing the tenant boundary.
notes: Groups are the three org-role groups, org-scoped with correct members; group_id path segment 'role:member' resolves (:path converter); PATCH add applied and committed; unknown group 404 SCIM error. Observation: PATCH add with a user id provisioned by another org succeeds by creating a membership in the CALLER's org only (writes bounded to caller org, other org's data untouched) - matches service design (all writes to caller's org membership table) but means any known numeric user id can be pulled into the key's org.

page: Depends(admit_analysis) on POST /validate and sibling compute routes
story: As the platform, I bound in-flight analyses so a burst returns clean retryable 429s instead of DB-pool 500s, and no single org starves the rest.
expected: Beyond MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYSES (default 8) globally the request gets 429 {code:'server_busy'} with Retry-After; beyond MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYSES_PER_ORG (default 3) for the caller's org it gets 429 {code:'org_at_capacity'} with Retry-After. Slots are always released in finally even when the analysis fails. Fails OPEN (no-op) for unauthenticated callers, unresolvable membership, or a membership-lookup DB error; ADMISSION_DISABLED bypass works only outside RELEASE — in production the gate cannot be switched off.
notes: Cheap part verified: unauthenticated POST /validate passes admission fail-open and gets a clean 401 auth_missing (no 429/500). Load-dependent sub-assertions NOT exercised per instructions: global 429 server_busy beyond 8 in-flight, per-org 429 org_at_capacity beyond 3, slot release in finally, RELEASE-mode bypass lockout.

story: As an org member, I propose a DRAFT rate-card/shop-profile version for admin review.
expected: Org member+ required; 400 if caller has no org, unknown asset_type, target version not found (404), or target not in 'draft' status (400). On success creates a 'proposed' request, emits an org-scoped admin-audience notification (governance.change_requested), and returns the serialized request. Rate-limited 60/hour.
notes: Proposing a draft rate-card version created a 'proposed' request (member+); unknown asset_type 400; target version not found 404; cross-org target 404; target not in draft status 400 (re-proposing a published version); governance.change_requested admin-audience notification emitted (seen in inbox, later resolved). 60/hour limit not exhausted.

story: As any org member (viewer+), I browse my org's change requests and open one.
expected: Viewer role required; list is org-scoped newest-first with optional ?status filter and returns an honest empty list when the caller has no org. Detail returns 404 for a missing request, another org's request, or a caller with no org — cross-tenant reads never succeed.
notes: List org-scoped newest-first ([3,2]); ?status filter honored (rejected -> [] before any rejection); org B list empty; detail 404 for missing and for another org's request; own-org detail 200.

story: As an org admin, I approve a proposed change, which publishes the target draft through the library's own publish path.
expected: Org-admin required; 404 unknown/cross-org request, 409 if the request is not in 'proposed' status. Publishing goes through the library's existing path — a publish failure surfaces that library error and the request is NOT marked approved (fail-closed). Success resolves the pending review notification, emits governance.approved + library.version_published audit events, and returns both the request and the published version.
notes: Org-admin approve 200 returning both request (approved, reviewed_by, decided_at) and published_version (status published); org-viewer 403; cross-org admin 404; re-approve 409 (not proposed); governance.approved + library.version_published audit events present; pending notification resolved. Publish-failure fail-closed branch not exercisable without breaking the library.

story: As an org admin, I reject a proposed change with an optional note; the draft stays a draft.
expected: Org-admin required; 404 unknown/cross-org, 409 if not 'proposed'. Rejection never mutates the target draft (it remains draft, nothing published), resolves the review notification, emits governance.rejected, and returns the request in 'rejected' state with the note.
notes: Reject 200 with status rejected + note persisted; cross-org 404; re-reject 409; target draft remained status=draft (nothing published); governance.rejected audit event present; review notification resolved.

story: As any org member (viewer+), I list my org's notifications with unread/dismissed/status filters.
expected: Viewer role required; org-scoped with per-user read/dismiss state, cursor-paginated (limit 1-100). status must match open|resolved|all; default shows unread non-dismissed; 400 when dismissed=true is combined with unread=true (contradictory). A caller with no org gets an honest empty list, not an error.
notes: Default list = unread non-dismissed open items; status must be open|resolved|all (bogus 422); dismissed=true+unread=true rejected 400; org-scoped (org B sees []); cursor pagination works (limit=1 -> has_more/next_cursor); resolved governance notifications visible under status=all. No-org honest-empty branch untestable.

story: As any org member, I mark a notification read, dismiss it from my inbox, or restore a dismissed one — affecting only my own view.
expected: Viewer role required; state (read_at/dismissed_at) is per-user, org-scoped — another org's notification id is not reachable. dismiss/restore return 404 when the caller has no org; read no-ops with {ok:true}. Each returns the updated serialized notification.
notes: read/dismiss/restore each return {ok,notification} with updated per-user read_at/dismissed_at; state is per-user (second member's view stayed unread after first user's read); another org's notification id 404; unknown id 404; dismissed item left default inbox and restore brought it back.

story: As any org member, I clear my unread badge in one call.
expected: Viewer role required; marks all of the caller's org notifications read for this user only and returns {ok:true, count, read_at}. No-org callers get count 0 with ok:true (honest no-op).
notes: Returns {ok:true,count,read_at}; marked only the caller's org notifications read for that user only (other member unaffected). No-org count-0 branch untestable.

story: As a security reviewer, I verify every API response carries hardening headers without breaking streaming bodies.
expected: Every HTTP response (including streamed CSV exports — pure-ASGI, not buffered) carries Strict-Transport-Security (max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy disabling camera/mic/geolocation, and Server rewritten to 'ProofShape' (stack never advertised). SECURITY_HEADERS_ENABLED=0 disables it (default on).
error_found: Server stack IS advertised: every backend response carries TWO Server headers - 'server: uvicorn' (uvicorn's own banner) followed by 'server: ProofShape' (middleware). Expected 'Server rewritten to ProofShape (stack never advertised)'. Reproduce: curl -sD - http://127.0.0.1:8000/health | grep -i '^server' -> 'server: uvicorn' + 'server: ProofShape'. Same on authed JSON, 404s, and streamed CSV. The middleware docstring says the uvicorn banner is suppressed via --no-server-header in the process command; the running process lacks that flag.
notes: All other assertions pass: HSTS max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=() present on every response including the streamed audit-log CSV export.

story: As an operator debugging an incident, I correlate a client request with logs and Sentry via one ID.
expected: An inbound X-Request-ID header is propagated; absent one, a UUID4 is generated. The ID is echoed back on the response as X-Request-ID, bound into structlog contextvars for every log line of the request, tagged onto the Sentry scope, and unbound after completion.
notes: Inbound X-Request-ID echoed verbatim on the response; absent header -> fresh UUID4 per request (two calls produced distinct UUIDs). Structlog/Sentry binding not externally observable via API.

page: Rate-limit + kill-switch behavior across identity/org/governance/notifications routes
story: As the platform, I throttle each route (e.g. 20/hour onboarding, 20/hour invites, 60/hour governance decisions, 120/hour reads) and gate all mutations behind the global kill-switch.
expected: Exceeding a route's slowapi limit returns 429; every mutating route in orgs/identity onboarding carries Depends(require_kill_switch_open) so writes are refused while the kill-switch is closed, while reads remain available — fail-closed for writes only.
notes: Per-route slowapi limit verified live: 20 invite creations succeeded, 21st returned 429 with Retry-After: 3600 and x-ratelimit-* headers. Kill-switch open state allows all mutations (verified throughout); the CLOSED state (503 service_paused on writes, reads still up) is driven by the ACCEPTING_NEW_ANALYSES env var of the running process and could not be flipped without restarting/modifying the app (forbidden) - dependency presence confirmed in code on all org/identity mutation routes.

story: As a recipient of a share link, I want to view the DFM analysis without logging in so that I can review the verdict and issues.
expected: Server component fetches the public backend endpoint /s/{shortId} (no auth); renders filename + verdict badge, geometry stat cards (faces, volume cm3, dimensions, watertight — each omitted when absent), issues sorted error>warning>info with codes and fix suggestions, and a process-ranking table sorted by score. A 404/revoked/failed fetch renders 'Analysis not available… may have been revoked by its owner' with a link home. OG metadata is generated from the data; page is noindex; header labels it 'Shared analysis · read-only'.
notes: Share created via POST /api/proxy/analyses/{id}/share -> /s/a4nVdkEHmqDo; viewed in a logged-out context. Bogus id shows the not-available (may have been revoked) state with a link home.

story: As a supplier or teammate, I want to view a shared should-cost decision without auth so that I see the recommendation with its honesty caveats intact.
expected: Fetches public /s/cost/{shortId}; renders 'Make by <process>' with DFM-ready/needs-redesign badge, a crossover sentence derived from decision.crossover_qty (or 'stays cheapest at every quantity tested', or 'costed but returned no make-vs-buy decision'), the travelling CostHonestyNote, verbatim confidence band (low–high, ±%, validated n or basis), geometry cards, a recommendation-by-quantity table with 'not DFM-ready' badges and 'cheaper if redesigned' alternates, and provenance-tagged assumption chips. Missing/revoked → 'Cost decision not available'. Noindex; footer states 'assumption-based, not a validated quote'.
notes: Cost share /s/cost/5WB6NT4UR5Fo viewed logged-out: "Make by CNC 3-Axis" + DFM-ready badge, crossover sentence ("Make below ~721 units... tool up with Die Casting above it"), confidence band ($68.76-$206.29/unit, ±50%, assumption-basis stated), geometry cards, recommendation-by-quantity table with cheaper-if-redesigned alternates, DEFAULT/USER provenance chips, noindex, "not a validated quote" footer. Bogus id -> "Cost decision not available".

story: As a visitor, I scroll the home page and see the five-act WebGL part story (hero, routed, glass box, assembly, $14.14 number, close) with captions fading in per section.
expected: Fixed WebGL PartStage renders behind content; a right-edge 6-stop progress rail (PART...PROOF) highlights the active act and clicking a dot scrolls to that section; a floating 'See it on your part' pill appears mid-story and links to /company#pilot; 'The full platform ->' links to /platform and 'or read the method first ->' links to /method. Page has no own metadata export, so tab title falls back to the (site) layout default 'ProofShape — verification, made of glass'.
notes: Tab title falls back to layout default 'ProofShape — verification, made of glass'; WebGL canvas renders (1 canvas, no console errors); rail nav[aria-label='Story progress'] has 6 stops PART|ROUTED|OPENED|SEATED|THE NUMBER|PROOF; clicking stop 5 scrolled 0->5130px; 'See it on your part' pill href=/company#pilot (opacity 1 mid-story); 'The full platform ->' -> /platform; 'or read the method first ->' -> /method.

story: As a visitor, I drag the quantity slider on the 'PROOF' act and watch the make-vs-tool-up recommendation flip at the 1,962-unit crossover.
expected: A range input (aria-label 'Quantity', log scale 1 to 10,000, default qty 500) updates the SVG curves, unit-cost readout, and highlighted curve; at qty <= 1962 the MJF 'make' branch is recommended, above it the injection-molding branch (qualified 'if redesigned'); an underline link below routes to /company#pilot.
notes: Range input aria-label='Quantity' default 500 units, 'Make by MJF (PP)'; dragged to 1,959 units -> MAKE, 1,995/10,000 units -> 'Tool up: injection molding' with 'if redesigned' qualifier — flips exactly at the documented 1,962 crossover; highlighted SVG curve stroke-widths swap (2.5<->1.5); readout and marker update; underline 'Request a pilot ->' -> /company#pilot.
